name: Angelise Ikaruga Misurugi
original_name: アンジュリーゼ・斑鳩・ミスルギ
source: Nicknamed and widely known as "Ange" in Arzenal, she is the first daughter and princess of the Misurugi Empire. However, on the day she was supposed to inherit the throne, her brother sold her out and revealed that she's actually a Norma. Right after the same event, Ange was stripped of her fame, honor and title and thrown into Arzenal. Due to her status as a former princess, Ange is very prideful and stubborn, and tends to get often into fights with the other members.
